content: In the future, we plan to extend our work by including more languages into the analysis. Using Russian and English allowed us to hypothesise about the importance of morphological character of a language. But we only scratched the surface of the linguistic diversity. To verify this claim, it is necessary to analyse more strongly inflected languages like Russian as well as more weakly inflected (analytical) languages similar to English. This will help to find out if the inflection differences are important for training deep learning models across human languages in general.
